observations: White game console with a glossy finish.
Two red boxes labeled 'Wireless Controller' are visible.
A black power cable and a black HDMI cable are present.
The console is resting on a cardboard surface.
A watermark 'GAME ARENA OFFICIAL' is visible across the center of the image.

claims.evidence: The console is visible in photo 0, but the model name is not legible on the front or any label.

claims.claim: Neatly used, never opened or repaired, no overheating, all ports working. Comes with the original pads and the UK receipt.
claims.evidence: No photo shows this; it is the seller's word only.

risks.risk: The console may not power on or may have a faulty HDMI port.
risks.proof: A video showing the console booting to the home screen and a clear shot of the HDMI port.

risks.risk: The optical disc drive may be defective.
risks.proof: A video of a game disc being inserted and ejected without error.
risks.if_unproven: as having a broken disc drive

risks.risk: The internal storage capacity (500GB vs 1TB) is unknown.
risks.proof: A photo of the 'Storage' settings screen in the system menu.

risks.risk: The console may be banned from the PlayStation Network (PSN).
risks.proof: A photo of the 'System Information' screen showing the console's serial number and online status.

proof_requests: Close-up of any label, sticker or metal plate showing the brand and model.
Video of the console powering on and navigating the system menu.
Photo of the 'Storage' screen showing the hard drive capacity.
Photo of the 'System Information' screen showing the model number and PSN status.
Photo of the rear ports to check for damage.
response.reason: What the item is shows, but not the model that sets its price: no photo shows it clearly enough to read. The shot asked for first would settle it.
